title: TinyMLP: A 2,410-Parameter Perceptron for Low-Resolution Handwritten Digits

reported.text: TinyMLP (code/ as released: a 64-32-10 perceptron with ReLU, on raw pixel counts 0..16 without scaling, trained with Adam, learning rate 1e-3, batches of 200, L2 1e-4, for 50 epochs). Validation accuracy (split full, n=359), mean +/- sample sd over seeds 0, 1, 2: 0.9118 +/- 0.0170 (per seed 0.9081, 0.8969, 0.9304); macro-F1 0.9121 +/- 0.0173. Over 20 seeds (0-19): full 0.9162 +/- 0.0133 (range 0.8886-0.9359); subset (n=141) 0.9043 +/- 0.0213 (range 0.8723-0.9504), and 0.8723 with seed 0. One run, one seed: about 1 s wall-clock on one Apple M4 Max CPU.

integrity_notes: min_delta 0.02 is about two standard errors of a 3-vs-3-seed difference on full (20-seed SD 0.0133, measured 2026-10-02). deny_read hides scikit-learn's bundled digits, which hold every evaluation image with its label; forbidden_in_diff stops a change from loading or downloading them.
